message:
Now let me look at the tail call handling in lvm.c. The vulnerability is about tail calls not being handled by `luaD_precall` in the same way as regular calls.

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>grep -n "tailcall\|OP_TAILCALL\|luaD_precall" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/lua/lvm.c | head -30</parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
